text.body:
* * * * * * tmāna sthiro deha jīvakaḥ | bahukālasamābhyāsāt sthiro bhavati śāśvate ||
paścānnāsti rujo dehe vārdhakyaṃ naiva dṛśyate | siddhaḥ sarvaguṇopeto nānāchnairupa sthitaḥ | gupta liṅgī sadākāle vartate vanamadhyataḥ ||
sutanurvitanuḥ kvāpi prāṇināṃ pravibhāsate | atarkya mahimā yasmāttasmāttaṃ nāvamānayet ||
aśraddhadhānaḥ pāpātmā nāstiko bhinna saṃśayaḥ | hetuko bakavṛttiśca teṣāṃ yogī na gocaraḥ ||
tasya līlāṃ na jānanti nindāṃ kurvanti ye'dhamāḥ | yogīśvarasya pāpiṣṭhāḥ patanti narake dhruvam ||
jano'pi yogināṃ dehe vitarkaṃ naiva kārayet | krīḍanti lokamadhye tu yathā vai prākṛto naraḥ ||
yogīśvarasya yogasya yogaśāstrasya pārvati | nindāṃ ca ye prakurvanti rākṣasāstena rākṣasaḥ ||
pāṣaṇḍinaḥ pāparatāḥ svadharma vimukhāstute | yaiścāvamānitoyogī teṣāṃ trātā na bhūtale ||
āyuḥ kāntiryaśaḥ puṇyaṃ naśyante tasya suvrate | yasya yoge matirdṛṣṭā jāyate mokṣarūpiṇī ||
svadharma pratikūloyo yogastasya na rocate | so'pi garbho bhavedduḥkhaṃ bhuṃjate ca nirantaram || 10 ||
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * | * * * * * * * * * * * * * saṃkṛte ||
p. 3)
caturāśīti lakṣe tu āsaneṣūttamā śṛṇu | ādi nāthena saṃproktaṃ padmāsanamihocyate ||
uttānau caraṇau kṛtvā ūrū saṃsthau prayatnataḥ | ūrumadhye tathottānau pāṇī kṛtvā tato dṛśau ||
nāsāgre vinyasetprājñaḥ dantamūlañca jihvayā | uttabhya cubukaṃ vakṣe saṃsthāpya pavanaṃ śanaiḥ ||
idaṃ padmāsanaṃ prokta sarvavyādhi vināśanam | durlabhaṃ yena kenāpi dhīmatā labhyate bhuvi ||
sāṃkṛte śṛṇu tatvajña yogābhyāsakramaṃ mayā | vakṣyamāṇaṃ prayatnena yogānāñca salakṣaṇaiḥ ||
yuvā vāpyati vṛddho vā vyādhito vā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | abhyāsāt siddhimāpnoti sarvayogeṣvatandritaḥ ||
brahmaṇā śramaṇovāpi bauddho vā patito'pi vā | kāpāliko vā cārvākaḥ śraddhayā sahitaḥ sudhīḥ ||
yogābhyāsarasonityaṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt | kriyā yuktasya siddhiḥ syādakriyasya kathaṃ bhavet ||
na śāstra pāṭhamātreṇa yogasiddhiḥ prajāyate ||
muṇḍī vā maṇḍadhārī vā kāṣāya vasano'pi vā | nārāyaṇa paro vāpi jaṭilo bhasma lepanaḥ ||
namaḥ śivāya vākyo vā bāhyārcā pūjako'pi vā | sthāna dvādaśa pūrākṣamālā bahu vibhūṣitaḥ ||
kriyāhīno'thavā krūraḥ kathaṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt | saveṣa dhāraṇaṃ siddhi kāraṇaṃ tañca tatkatham | kriyaiva kāraṇaṃ siddhessatyamecca sāṃkṛte ||
śiśnodarārtha yogaśca kathayaṃ yogadhāraṇaḥ | anuṣṭhāna vihīnāstu vañcayanti janāḥ kila ||
p. 4)
uccāvacā vipralaṃbhāmūḍhā yogaparāyaṇāḥ | śanaistān tadvidhājñātvā yogābhyāsa vivarjitān ||
kṛtvārtha vañcane naiva varjayedveṣadhāriṇaḥ | yadasti vighna bhūtāni yogābhyāsasya sarvadā ||
varjayet tadviśeṣeṇa īdṛśān siddhijāḥ kriyāḥ | prathamābhyāsakāle tu pramādā vividhā mune || 16 ||
ālasyaṃ prathamo vighno dvitīyastu prakathyate | pūrvoktadhūrta goṣṭhī ca tṛtīyomantrasādhanam ||
caturtho dhātu vādaśca kakṣyāvādastu pañcamaḥ | ityevaṃ bahavo vighnāḥ mṛgatṛṣṇā samāmune ||
sthirāsanasya jāyante tān jñātvā santyajet sudhīḥ | prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryāt padmāsanagataḥ svayam | suśobhanaṃ maṭhaṃ kuryāt sūkṣmadvārañca nirbraṇam ||
suṣṭhu liptaṃ gomayena sudhayā vā prayatnataḥ | matkuṇaiḥ maśakairlūtairvarjitañca dine dine ||
saṃmṛṣṭaṃ saṃmārjanyā * * * * * na tandritaḥ | vāsitañca sugandhena dhūpitaṃ guggulādibhiḥ | malamūtrādibhirvegairaṣṭādaśabhireva ca ||
varjitaścānna sampannaṃ kabalādina saṃyutam | nātyunnataṃ nātinī caṃ parasaṅga vivarjitam ||
tasmin maṭhe samāstīrya hyāsanaṃ nistaraṅgakam | tatropaviśyamedhāvī padmāsana samanvitaḥ | ṛju kāyaḥ prāñjaliśca praṇamyābhīṣṭa devatāḥ ||
tato dakṣiṇahastasyāṅguṣṭhe naiva piṅgalām | nirudhya pūrayedvāyumiḍayā tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
yathā śaktyā nirodhena tataḥ kuryācca kumbhakam ||
p. 5)
punastyajet piṅgalayā śanaireva na vegataḥ | punaḥ piṅgalyā pūrya pūrayedudaraṃ śanaiḥ ||
dhārayitvā yathā śaktirecayediḍyā śanaiḥ | yathā tyajet yathā pūrya dhārayedanirodhanaḥ ||
evaṃ prātaḥ prakūrvīta śaktyā viṃśati saṃkhyayā | kumbhakaḥ sahito nāma sarvagraha vivarjitaḥ ||
evamevārdha rātre'pi punarviṃśati kumbhakān | kurvīta recapūrābhyāṃ sahitaṃ prati vāsaram ||
sahito recapūrābhyāṃ tasmātsahita kumbhakaḥ | evaṃ māsatrayaṃ kuryānnāḍīśuddhistato bhavet ||
yadā tu nāḍiśuddhiḥ syāt tadā cihnāni bāhyataḥ | jāyante yogino dehe tāni vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ||
śarīra laghutādīptirvahnerjaṭhara vartinaḥ | kṛśatvaṃ ca śarīrasya tadā jāyeta niścitam || 17 ||
tathā bhojyāni vakṣyāmi kṣipraṃ yoga prasiddhaye | kṣīraṃ ghṛtañca miṣṭānnaṃ mitāhārañca śasyate ||
pūrvokta kāle kuryācca pavanābhyāsameva ca | tataḥ paraṃ yatheṣṭhaṃ tu śaktiḥ syādvāyudhāraṇe ||
yatheṣṭha dhāraṇādvāyoḥ siddhyet kevala kumbhakaḥ | kevale kumbhake siddhe recapūra vivarjite ||
na tatra durlabhaṃ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate | prasvedo jāyate pūrvaṃ mardanaṃ tena kārayet ||
tato'pi dhāraṇādvāyoḥ krameṇaiva śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | ka pā bhavati dehasya āsane tasya yoginaḥ ||
tato'dhikatarābhyāsāddurdaro jāyate dhruvam | yathā ca dadadrurodghoṣamutpatyotpatya bhūtale ||
p. 6)
padmāsana sthito yogī tathā ca gati bhūtale | tatodhikatarābhyāsādbhūmistyāgaśca jāyate ||
padmāsanastha evāsau bhūmimaspṛśya vartate | nirādhāro vicitraṃ hi tathā sāmarthyamāpnuyāt ||
abhuktvā yadi vā bhuktvā yogī na vyathate tathā | alpamūtra purīṣaḥ syāt svalpanidrā ca jāyate | kīṭakā dūṣitā lālā svedo durgandhatānane ||
etāni sarvadā tasya na jāyante tataḥ param | tatodhika tarābhyāsāt balamutpadyate bhṛśam ||
yena bhūcarasiddhissyādbhūcaraṇāṃ jaye kṣamaḥ | vyāghro lulāyo vanyo vā gavayo gaja eva vā ||
siṃho vā yoginā tena mriyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | * * rpasya samorūpaḥ tadā tasyaiva yoginaḥ ||
tasmin kāle mahāvighno yoginaḥ syāt pramādataḥ | tadrūpa vaśagānārya kāsṛ?kṣante tasya saṅgamam | yadi saṅgaṃ karotyeva bindustasya vinaśyati ||
āyuḥ kṣayo bindu hāni rasāmarthyañca jāyate | tasmāt strīṇāṃ varjya saṅgaṃ kuryādabhyāsamādarāt ||
yogino'ṅge sugandhaḥ syāt satataṃ bindudhāraṇāt | tasmāt sarva prayatnena bindurakṣā hi yoginaḥ | tato rahasyupāviṣṭaḥ praṇavaṃ plutaṃ mātrayā ||
japet pūrvārjitānāñca pāpānāṃ nāśahatave | sarva vighna haraścāyaṃ praṇavassarva doṣahā ||
evamabhyāsa yogena siddhirāraṃbha saṃbhavā | bhavettato ghaṭāvasthā pavanābhyāsatassadā ||
prāṇāpāno manovāyurjīvātma paramātmanoḥ | anyonyasyā viśuddhenaikatāṃ ghaṭe yataḥ | tasmād ghaṭākhyāyāvasthā prasiddhā yoginaḥ smṛtā ||
tatra cihnāni yāni syustāni vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ | pūrvaṃ catkathitābhyāsa caturthātsaṃparityajet ||
divā vā yadi vā rātrau yāma mātraṃ samabhyaset | ekavāraṃ pṛ kuryāt kevala kumbhakam | pratyāhāro yamenasyā deva kartuṃ hi yoginaḥ ||
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo yaḥ pratyāharati svayam | yogīkumbhakamāsthāya pratyāhāraḥ sa ucyate ||
yadyat paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ taṃtamātmeti bhāvayet | yadyacchruṇoti karṇābhyātaṃtamātmeti bhāvayet ||
yadyajjighrati nāsāyāṃ taṃtamātmeti bhāvayet | jihvayā yadrasayatitaṃtamātmeti bhāvayet ||
tvacā yat spṛśyate yogī taṃtamātmeti bhāvayet ||
evaṃ jñānendriyāṇāñca tattatsaṃkhyāñca bhāvayet | yāmamātraṃ pratidinaṃ yogī yatnādatandritaḥ ||
tato vicitrasāmarthyaṃ jāyate yogino bhṛśam | dūradṛṣṭirdūraśrutiḥ kṣaṇāddūrā gamastathā | khecaratvaṃ hi jāyeta santatābhyāsa yogataḥ ||
tathā buddhimatāṃ bhāvyaṃ yogināṃ yogasiddhaye | ete vighnā mahāsiddhernarametteṣu buddhimān ||
na darśayecca lokāya svasāmarthyaṃ hi sarvadā | kadāciddarśayet prītyā bhakti yuktāya vā punaḥ ||
yathā mukto yathā mūḍho yathā badhira eva vā | tathā varteta lokeṣu svasāmarthyasya guptaye ||
p. 8)
nocecchiṣya bahavo bhavantyeva priyaṅkarāḥ | svasvakāryeṣu yogīndraṃ prārthayanti na saṃśayaḥ ||
tatkarmakāraṇātyugra svābhyāso vismṛto bhavet | abhyāsena vihīnastu tato laukikatāṃ vrajet ||
avismṛtya gurorvākyamabhyaset tadaharniśam | evaṃ bhaved ghaṭāvasthā satatābhyāsayogataḥ ||
anabhyāsena taccaiva vṛthā goṣṭhyo na siddhyati | tasmāt sarva prayatnena yogameva samabhyaset | tataḥ paricayāvasthā jāyate bhyāsa yogataḥ ||
vāyuḥ paricito yasmāt agninā sahakuṇḍalīm | bodhayitvā suṣumnāyāṃ praviśedavirodhataḥ ||
vāyunā saha cittañca praviśecca mahāpatham | mahāpatha śmaśānaṃ ca suṣumnāpyekameva hi | nāmnā maṃtāntare bhedaḥ phalabhedena vidyate ||
vartamānaṃ bhaviṣyañca bhūtāsannaiva veṣṭhiyam | yasya citraṃ savapanaṃ suṣumnaṃ praviśediha ||
bhāvyānyarthāni vijñeyā yogorahasti yatnataḥ | pañcavādhāraṇaṃ kuryāt tattadbhūta bhayāpahām ||
nābheradho gudasyordhvaṃ ghuṭikā pañcadhārayet | vāyvo labhate pṛthvī dhāraṇāt tadbhayāpahā ||
pṛthivī saṃbhavo mṛtyurna bhavedasya yoginaḥ |
iti pṛthvī dhāraṇā ||
nābhisthāna tato vāyuḥ dhārayet pañca nāḍikāḥ ||
agni yathā vidhanna mṛtyustasya vahninā | nadahyataśśarīrañca pratiṣṭhedagni maṇḍala ityagni dhāraṇam ||
nābhi bhrūghrāṇa madhye tu pradeśa trayasaṃmite | dhārayat pañcaghaṭikāṃ vāyuśeṣā hi vāyavi ||
p. 9)
dhāraṇānna tu vāyvostu bhayaṃ bhavatu yoginaḥ || iti vāyu dhāraṇā || bhrumadhyādupari tu dhārayet pañcanāḍikāḥ | vāyuṃ yogī prayatnena vyayamākāśa dhāraṇā || ākāśadhāraṇaṃ kurvan mṛtyuṃ jayati adbhutam | yatra kutra sthito vāpi sukhamatyantamaśnute || iti pañca vidhāṃ bhūtāṃ bhūtadhāraṇāṃ yaḥ samabhyaset | brahmaṇaḥ pralayedyāpi tasya mṛtyurna vidyate || samabhyaset tadā dhyānaṃ ghaṭikā ṣaṣṭimeva ca | vāyumārudhya cākārādevatāmiṣṭadāyinīm || saguṇa dhyānametasya daṇimādi guṇa pradam | nirguṇaṃ khamiva dhyātvā mokṣamārgaṃ prapadyate || nirguṇadhyānametañca samādhiñca tato bhyaset | dinadvādaśakenaiva samādhiṃ samavāpnuyāt || vāyuṃ nirudhya medhāvī jīvanmukto bhaved dṛḍham | samādhiḥ samatāvasthā jīvātma paramātmanoḥ ||
yadi svadehamutsṛṣṭamicchecchedudvrajet svayam | para brahmaṇi līyante tyaktvā karma śubhāśubham ||
acanocet samutsraṣṭuṃ svaśarīraṃ yadi priyam | sarvalokeṣu vicaret dakṣiṇamādi guṇānvitaḥ ||
kadācitsvecchayā deho bhūtvā svarge'pi saṃbhave | manuṣyo vāpi yoṣā vā svecchayā pekṣaṇādbhavet ||
siṃho vyāghra gajo vā syāt icchayā jantunāṃ vrajet | yadīṣṭameva dhatte tu yogī yadyanmaheśvaraḥ | kapi mārgo'yamuktaste sāṃskṛteṣṭāṃga yogataḥ ||
tato bhavedrāja yogonānāntarā bhavati dhruvam | na cinmātreṇa siddhiḥ syāt dabhyāsādeva jāyate ||
rāja yogapadaṃ prāpya sarvasatvavaśaṃkara | sarvaṃ kuryānnavā kuryādyathā ruciviśeṣayet ||
yathā tu rājayogena niṣpannā yoginaḥ kriya | tadā vasthā diniṣpannā unmanyā nandarūpiṇī ||
saṃsiddhā yoginaścāsya bhuktimukti pradāpayet | sarvaṃ tu kalitaṃ brahman saṃsmṛtaṃ yogamācaret || 16 ||
sarvasiddhimavāpyāsmaddattātreya prasādataḥ | yastaditthaṃ paṭhennityaṃ sādhubhyaḥ kathayediti | tasya yoga krameṇaiva sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||
p. 10)
yoginobhyāsa saṃsaktā araṇyeṣu gṛheṣu vā | bahukālaṃ ramantyeva janasaṃghavivarjitāḥ ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena sāṃgameva samabhyaset ||
yogābhyāso janma phalaṃ niṣphalā itarāḥ kriyāḥ | mahāmāyā prabhāveṇa sarveṣāmastu citsukham | yatnassarvastadāyattattāmevā rādhayet tataḥ ||
iti dattātreyabodhaḥ samāptaḥ ||
|| hariḥ oṃ ||
śubhamastu ||
